queries.name: servidores_unidades
queries.sql:
SELECT
    u.codigo,
    u.nombre,
    CONVERT(varchar(36), u.id) AS unidad_guid,
    u.server_id AS server_id_texto,
    CONVERT(
        varchar(36),
        TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id)
    ) AS server_guid,
    CASE
        WHEN TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id) IS NULL
        THEN 'INVALID_GUID'
        ELSE 'VALID_GUID'
    END AS conversion_estado
FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u
WHERE u.activo = 1
ORDER BY u.nombre

queries.name: servidores_compartidos
queries.sql:
SELECT
    u.server_id,
    COUNT(*) AS unidades_activas
FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u
WHERE u.activo = 1
GROUP BY u.server_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY unidades_activas DESC

queries.name: coincidencia_servidores
queries.sql:
SELECT
    u.codigo,
    u.nombre,
    CONVERT(varchar(36),
        TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id)
    ) AS server_guid,
    (
        SELECT COUNT_BIG(*)
        FROM dbo.Sync_Productos p
        WHERE p.ServerID =
            TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id)
    ) AS productos,
    (
        SELECT COUNT_BIG(*)
        FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos i
        WHERE i.ServerID =
            TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id)
    ) AS insumos,
    (
        SELECT COUNT_BIG(*)
        FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
        WHERE r.ServerID =
            TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, u.server_id)
    ) AS componentes_receta
FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u
WHERE u.activo = 1
ORDER BY u.nombre

queries.name: producto_unidad_id_distribucion
queries.sql:
SELECT
    p.UnidadNegocioID,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS productos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ServerID) AS servidores_distintos
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos p
GROUP BY p.UnidadNegocioID
ORDER BY productos DESC

queries.name: catalogo_relaciones_candidatas
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS tabla,
    c.name AS columna,
    ty.name AS tipo_sql
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns c
    ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types ty
    ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE s.name = 'dbo'
AND (
    t.name IN (
        'Unidades_Negocio',
        'Sistema_Empresas',
        'Sync_Productos'
    )
)
AND (
    c.name LIKE '%Unidad%'
    OR c.name LIKE '%Empresa%'
    OR c.name LIKE '%Server%'
    OR c.name IN ('id', 'codigo')
)
ORDER BY t.name, c.name

objective: Auditar relaciones canonicas entre unidades operativas, servidores, productos, insumos y recetas. Verificar tipos, conversiones, correspondencias y cardinalidades sin modificar SQL ni consultar POS LIVE.
